_README: Anti-bandaid ratchet (Mandate M1). Baseline = audit-measured 2026-05-28 truth. Each number may only DECREASE; CI (check-cleanup-budget.mjs) fails if any rises. Lower these at every phase boundary. Phase-4 ship-gate targets: cron_count<=~24, duplicate_identity_modules=0, resolver_reassign_calls=0, grandfather_entries=0, migration_files=1 (post-flatten). Re-snapshot deliberately with --update; the diff is the human decision point.
resolver_reassign_calls_justification: couple_notifications table (mig 389) added to mergeWeddings reassign list
migration_files_justification: wave 3 contract 2026-09-09: 398 couples.handles + first_seen_at + fragments.handles (HANDLE-IDENTITY-SPEC.md); 395/397 still to apply; flatten to tracked baseline still owed post-reimport. 2026-09-11, W28 added 401_instagram_connections: a venue-scoped row holding the Instagram business account id, because entry[].id is the only routing key a Meta webhook carries, plus the page-token reference the Graph sender lookup needs. No existing table can hold it (openphone_connections is phone-shaped, venue_config is not a credential store). The number is NOT raised: the count was one below budget, so 401 lands inside the existing headroom and the ratchet stays at 396.
